The test suite markers are `integration`, `advanced`, `live`, and `live_network`. Run the fail-closed offline suite with `DOCMANCER_OFFLINE=1 pytest tests/ -m "not advanced and not live and not live_network"`.

The model-visible projection is the bounded evidence material exposed to the caller. The projection is token-bounded by a maximum visible-token budget and only assigned witnesses count toward that limit.
